summary: whatsapp-network-recovery gains its 2026.10.9 variant (packages table): same transport-recovery patch on @openclaw/whatsapp 2026.10.9 (connection-controller-CejM7bhn, monitor-DVzumwCI) and openclaw 2026.10.9 (server-runtime-startup-services-CSJSnUKS). No change on the installed 2026.9.6.
reason: OpenClaw 2026.10.9 upgrade prep. The 2026.10.9 WhatsApp controller still stops the channel after reconnectPolicy.maxAttempts on a transport loss (DNS, reset, unreachable) and has no slow retry; the S24 needs the existing recovery patch there too. Upstream moved heartbeatSeconds, reconnectPolicy and keepAlive under this.params and merged the setup-error and unstable-auth decisions, so four anchors are rewritten; the behaviour is the 2026.9.6 one.
